name: WPForms Lite
storage_notes: Forms are CPT wpforms (plus wpforms-template for user templates). Each form's fields and settings are one JSON document in post_content; wpforms_encode() adds wp_slash() around wp_json_encode(), and wpforms_decode() json_decodes then wp_unslash(). post_title/post_excerpt mirror settings.form_title/form_desc. Plugin settings are one option wpforms_settings array. Lite does not store entry content; it stores submission counters in post meta wpforms_entries_count and a rolling option wpforms_entries_count_daily. No form CRUD REST API is registered (CPT is not public and has no show_in_rest).

settings.summary: Single settings array keyed by field ids. Save merges only the submitted view's fields into the existing array; preserve all other keys.

fields.uninstall-data: bool, delete all data on uninstall
fields.currency: string ISO currency code, default USD

settings.summary: Installed version used by Pro migrations and health checks. Written on install/upgrade.
Installed Lite version used by Lite migrations. Written on install/upgrade.
Rolling 30-day submission counters per UTC day for Lite reports. Maintained by the plugin; read-only for PressAgent.
License/type/key array read by access checks. Populated by Pro licensing; unlicensed in Lite. Treat as read-only.

meta.summary: Locations where a form is embedded (pages/posts/widgets/blocks). Maintained by the Locator.
meta.format_notes: Plugin-managed cache of embed locations; updated on form save/embed changes. Read-only for PressAgent.

meta.summary: Lifetime submission count per form (Lite stores counters, not entry data).
meta.format_notes: Incremented by add_post_meta/update_post_meta on submission; read-only.

meta.summary: Weekly counter snapshot used by Lite email summaries.

actions.name: list_forms
actions.summary: List forms. get() defaults to post_status=publish; pass post_status=any to include trash/draft.

actions.name: get_form
actions.summary: Read one form post or decoded form data.

actions.name: create_form
actions.summary: Create a minimal form, then update it with full fields/settings. add() sets post_type wpforms, title, and initial form_title/form_desc.

params.title: string
params.data: additional data; builder=false adds default notification settings

actions.name: update_form
actions.summary: Replace a form's fields/settings JSON; preserves form meta and per-field meta where possible.

params.form_data: array with fields, settings, meta, field_id

actions.name: delete_form
actions.summary: Permanently delete one or more forms (and any entry tables for those IDs when present).

actions.name: duplicate_form
actions.summary: Duplicate forms and return the new IDs.

actions.name: update_form_meta
actions.summary: Update a key inside the JSON meta object of a form.

actions.name: save_settings
actions.summary: Persist the full settings array; merge first so unrelated keys are not lost.

objects.storage: CPT wpforms; JSON in post_content (slashed), title/description mirrored in post_title/post_excerpt; JSON keys fields/settings/meta/field_id
objects.summary: A form with fields, notification/confirmation settings and internal meta.
objects.crud_notes: List/get with wpforms()->obj('form')->get(); create with add() then update(); update replaces the decoded form data and re-encodes it; delete() is permanent. Fields are keyed by numeric id and field_id must exceed the largest id (next_field_id()). Do not write post_content directly.

objects.storage: CPT wpforms-template; same JSON post_content format
objects.summary: User-saved form templates shown in the builder.
objects.crud_notes: Same Form Handler methods with post_type wpforms-template; list via get('', ['post_type'=>'wpforms-template']). Creating/updating mirrors form data.

detection.active_check: defined('WPFORMS_VERSION') or function_exists('wpforms'); plugin basename WPFORMS_PLUGIN_FILE (wpforms-lite/wpforms.php)

pro_notes: Entry storage and entry management are Pro-only. Lite explicitly states entries are not stored (lite/wpforms-lite.php:691); its Entries screens render sample data/upsell (lite/wpforms-lite.php:832) and only counters are kept locally (lite/wpforms-lite.php:938). Lite Connect can back up submissions to the cloud, but that was not verified as local entry CRUD.
Multiple email notifications: Lite keeps only the first notification (includes/class-process.php:1948); additional notifications are a Pro capability.
Pro license/type data lives in option wpforms_license (includes/functions/access.php:75); Pro addons and per-form access controls are outside this free-source analysis.
gotchas: There is no form CRUD REST API: the wpforms CPT is registered with public=false, show_ui=false and no show_in_rest (includes/class-form.php:93,110). Manage forms through the PHP API or the builder admin-ajax endpoint.

Form data is not plain JSON in the DB: wpforms_encode() stores wp_slash(wp_json_encode($data)) (includes/functions/forms.php:108). Raw update_post_meta/post_content writes will be double-unescaped or corrupted; always use Form Handler update()/add().
get() defaults to post_status=publish (includes/class-form.php:238); pass post_status=any to list trashed/draft forms.
update() replaces the whole decoded form data and preserves only specific meta/field metadata; send fields, settings, meta and field_id, not a partial fragment (includes/class-form.php:671).

wpforms_settings is one array: the admin save merges the current view into existing settings (includes/admin/class-settings.php:191); wpforms_update_settings() replaces the option, so merge before calling it.
Lite stores no entry content, only counters; do not promise entry listing/export on a Lite site. Multiple notifications beyond the first are ignored (includes/class-process.php:1948).
The CPT has supports title/author/revisions only and capability_type wpforms_form; Lite capability checks collapse to manage_options (src/Access/Capabilities.php:44).
Field IDs are strings/ints inside fields{}; keep field_id greater than the largest field id or use next_field_id() (includes/class-form.php:1233).
Form title is stored twice: post_title and settings.form_title (includes/class-form.php:699); keep them consistent.
Form data slashing can be toggled with the wpforms_enable_form_data_slashing filter / WPFORMS_ENABLE_FORM_DATA_SLASHING constant (includes/functions/forms.php:579); test on unusual installs.
